scope: 15 requested European catalogue flag jurisdictions; assets and provenance only, root integrates mappings/shared attribution.

method.sources: Flag-icons pinned v7.3.2 MIT for Åland/Montenegro/Serbia; exact Commons image metadata and file-page licence/jurisdiction reading for 12 regional flags.
method.network: One batched Commons metadata GET succeeded. Upcoming downloads use shared cached /tmp/parliament-flag-fetch.py helper with global Commons pace/hold. Stop regional downloads on HTTP429/Retry-After; no bypass hosts.
method.licensing: Each source licence reviewed before fetching asset. Copyright permission is separate from official-insignia rules. Artwork unchanged in every asset; 13 files byte-identical to downloads, Hesse/Thuringia only remove external DTD declarations.
method.svg_security: Each downloaded SVG parsed and checked before entering assets; SHA-256 recorded, Commons SHA-1 compared when present.
